mainEntity.name: How long does a typical software development project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every timeline depends on the project's scope, technical complexity, required features, and integrations. Smaller projects can be completed within a few weeks, while larger custom platforms take longer. We agree a realistic schedule during planning, before development begins.

mainEntity.name: How can my business start a software development project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by booking a call with our team. We discuss your goals, current challenges, and project requirements, then recommend a suitable technical approach. You will receive a proposal covering scope, timeline, and costs before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: How will I receive updates during the development process?

acceptedAnswer.text: We follow an agile development approach, delivering work in stages and sharing progress regularly. You can review completed features, give feedback, and stay informed about upcoming tasks, so there are no surprises when your project reaches launch.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide support and maintenance after project delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. After launch, we can help with bug fixes, troubleshooting, performance improvements, security updates, and new features. Support arrangements are agreed based on your project's needs, ensuring your software stays stable and continues to grow with your business.
